contexts.text: Some inherit such a softness of heart; some acquire it; but it is a false conscience.
Their influx was soft.
(Their speech) softens the words.
(Infants of a celestial genius) think, speak, and act with more softness... But the spiritual, not so softly.
They cannot receive... until the Persuasive... is as it were softened.
Infested me by a soft influx.
These vessels... must be softened; and this softening is effected... by temptations.
His words are softer than oil (). Here the heart and the soft things thence are predicated of evil. (See AE 537:10.)
The good of love to God, and the good of charity... are as it were soft and yielding.
He acted by a gentle and soft influx.
The thymus gland is then soft.
Truth from good (there) appears as soft; but falsity from evil as hard.
Those in good are as it were soft.
(The speech of the Spirits of Mars) was soft in its flow; a softer one I have not perceived; it was like the softest breeze.
Charity with faith is yielding and soft.
That all things of the discourse of the Angels are open to the Lord... is heard from the softness and its quality.

That the Word in the letter (appears) rude and obscure; but in the internal sense, soft and resplendent, is signified by their not seeing a man clothed in soft raiment; lo, they who wear soft things are in kings' houses ().
A humble heart is soft...
Signifies truth from a celestial origin, from its whiteness and softness.
The influx (of the infants) was so tender and soft.
Hence softening of the heart...
The intelligence of women is soft, etc.
They softened the snow.
A Society of such acts softly.
The celestial love soft words and letters. Explained. DeVerbo 4:2.
The softer a man is, the more perfect he is. Explained.
Love to the Divine is soft.
Not softened with oil () = not tempered by good.
